selection_reason: S004 provides the state matrix structure (4×4 bytes, column-major order) necessary to declare the state_matrix register.
S005 defines the FSM states and the round counter (dcnt) required to declare fsm_state and round_counter registers.
S001 establishes that the design includes a key expansion unit and an inverse S-box, justifying the instantiation of aes_key_expand and aes_inv_sbox.
S003 specifies the inverse round transformations and their exact ordering (InvShiftRows, InvSubBytes, AddRoundKey, InvMixColumns).
S004 provides the detailed mathematical formulas for each transformation (shift patterns, GF multipliers, XOR).
S005 defines that the FinalRound omits InvMixColumns, which the combinational network must conditionally implement.
S005 contains the complete operational phase state machine (states, transitions, and control actions) that B4 must implement.
S004 gives the mapping from the state matrix to the plaintext output (column-major order) needed to drive text_out.
S005 specifies the Done phase semantics and when the done signal must be asserted.
